_note: UserPromptSubmit hook: injects a RuvNet grounding directive into context ONLY when the prompt is RuvNet-relevant (keyword-gated to keep noise low). stdout from a UserPromptSubmit hook is injected into the model's context by the harness every prompt — this is the enforcement primitive that makes grounding non-optional. The script always exits 0 and is guarded with `|| true` so it can never block or error a turn.
